text:
24-hour news summary.

1. (https://t.me/dlmehr/5032) Users report that OpenAI’s Astra is already producing state-of-the-art results, though project-generation bugs remain.

2. (https://t.me/dlmehr/5033) Early Astra demonstrations suggest it can generate highly sophisticated applications, including detailed sci-fi spaceship interfaces.

3. (https://t.me/dlmehr/5034) An MIT-linked report warns that AI can now credibly complete most undergraduate assignments, requiring major changes to teaching and assessment.

4. (https://t.me/dlmehr/5035) Local AI enthusiasts say several models now offer frontier-level, private inference on a roughly $9,000 dual-DGX Spark setup.

5. (https://t.me/dlmehr/5036) A reported Astra checkpoint one-shotted a GTA-style game clone using maximum reasoning.

6. (https://t.me/dlmehr/5037) Astra is reportedly designed for weeks-long work, coordinating agents, operating software, creating presentations, and analyzing complex data.

7. (https://t.me/dlmehr/5038) AI’s ability to complete undergraduate assignments is creating major challenges for education and academic integrity.

8. (https://t.me/dlmehr/5039) Leaks claim Cursor’s Composer 3 may launch next week with multiple reasoning modes and stronger coding performance.

9. (https://t.me/dlmehr/5040) OpenAI reportedly bought tens of thousands of Macs for reinforcement learning, while Anthropic rents them as Apple emerges as a local-AI rival to Nvidia.

10. (https://t.me/dlmehr/5041) Commentary warns that habitual AI-assisted cheating could have serious consequences for young people’s moral development.

11. (https://t.me/dlmehr/5042) Dario Amodei says Anthropic delayed its first Claude release by about six months, sacrificing a potential early lead.

12. (https://t.me/dlmehr/5043) Critics question Anthropic’s lack of recent wet-lab and drug-discovery updates amid ambitious claims about accelerating biology and curing disease.

13. (https://t.me/dlmehr/5044) Taalas reportedly demonstrated AI generation at about 14,000 tokens per second, vastly exceeding typical ChatGPT speeds.

--Hermes
